 We're hiring a Junior Full\-Stack Product Engineer to build the web apps and internal tools that run our K\-12 campuses. You'll own features end to end in a TypeScript stack: React and Tailwind on the frontend, Node and API routes on the backend, Postgres for data. The bar is the product itself, with real users, real features, and real polish.
   

  

 This is early\-career, but we want someone who already ships full products on their own. If you've built a TypeScript app end to end, designed a schema, written the API, shipped the UI, and put it in front of real users, you're the kind of engineer we want to talk to. We care more about what you've built than where you went to school.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Build Full\-Stack Features in TypeScript: Own features end to end in a TypeScript stack (Next.js, React, Node), from the UI to the API routes to the database schema. Ship them to production and iterate based on how people actually use them.
* Design UI That Holds Up: Build clean, responsive interfaces in React and Tailwind that work the first time on a parent's phone and a coach's laptop. You care how it looks, not just whether it renders.
* Own the Backend Behind Your Features: Write the API routes, data models, and database queries that power what you build. Postgres, Prisma or Drizzle, and basic auth patterns are not someone else's job.
* Think in Products, Not Tickets: Take a rough problem from a coach, parent, or operator, scope it into something shippable, and decide what to build and what to cut. Push back when the spec is wrong.
* Model Data and Write the Queries: Design Postgres schemas, write the migrations, and tune the queries your features depend on. Use Prisma or Drizzle as the ORM, and drop down to raw SQL when it's the right call.
* Integrate the Tools We Run On: Build the integrations and webhooks that connect our app to Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, Workable, and our AI providers.
* Keep Production Healthy: Handle the parts that are not glamorous: logging, error states, loading states, monitoring, and the small details that keep a product from feeling cheap.


**Requirements**
* You've Shipped Full\-Stack TypeScript Apps: Not a tutorial clone. Something you built end to end in Next.js or a similar TypeScript framework, with a real database, real users, and a real URL. Be ready to walk us through how you built it and what you'd do differently.

* You Care About the Frontend: You write clean React, you have opinions about component structure and state management, and you notice when spacing, typography, or loading behavior is off.
* You Can Own the Backend Too: You can model data in Postgres, write the API, handle auth, and reason about performance. You don't bounce off the database layer.
* Comfortable Across the Stack: You can jump from a React component to an API route to a database migration in the same afternoon and not slow down. You don't have a side of the stack you avoid.

 Bonus Points
   

  

* Design Sense: You're comfortable in Figma, can take a rough sketch to a working UI, and have a point of view on what good product design looks like.
* Public Work to Show: A GitHub profile, a live side project, a personal site, or a writeup of something you built. Anything that lets us see how you think and what you have done.
* Experience with Our Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Postgres, Prisma or Drizzle, tRPC, Vercel. Not required, but a head start.
* SQL and Light Data Work: You're comfortable writing queries, cleaning up data, and building small internal dashboards when the situation calls for it.

 Patient \& Family Experiences

 Internal Automation Systems

 Platform Foundations

 , a boutique law firm specializing in family law, is seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive
 **Document Automation \& Integration Engineer** 
 to support the implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of the firm's document automation initiatives. The
 **Document Automation \& Integration Engineer** 
 will serve as the firm's subject matter expert for document generation and automation solutions. This role will help modernize and scale the way legal documents are created, managed, and delivered across the firm.
   

  

 This position will partner closely with attorneys, legal staff, operations leaders, Salesforce administrators, business systems stakeholders, and software developers to evaluate, implement, and optimize document automation technologies. The successful candidate will design and maintain automated document workflows, develop scalable document generation processes, and help establish best practices for document automation across the organization.
   

  

 While this is not primarily a software development role, the Document Automation \& Integration Engineer will work closely with the Technology team to ensure document automation solutions integrate effectively with Salesforce, the firm's business systems, and other technology platforms.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who has successfully implemented document automation solutions, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Document Automation Leadership
   

  

* Serve as the firm's primary subject matter expert for document automation solutions, processes, and best practices.
* Support the firm's document automation strategy by providing recommendations on technologies, processes, workflow improvements, and scalable solutions.
* Participate in the evaluation, implementation, and ongoing optimization of document automation platforms and related technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, accuracy, and scalability through document automation.
* Establish standards and best practices for automated document generation, template maintenance, and workflow management.

* Design, configure, and maintain integrations between Salesforce, document automation platforms, document storage systems, and other business applications.
* Build and support API\-driven workflows for document generation, data synchronization, and process automation.
* Configure and troubleshoot REST APIs, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and integration end points.
* Define and manage data mappings, transformation rules, validation logic, and synchronization processes across systems.
* Collaborate with internal and external technology partners to implement and support integration solutions.
* Monitor and resolve integration failures, API issues, data quality concerns, and workflow exceptions.

* Translate legal, operational, and business requirements into scalable document automation solutions.

* Define data requirements, mapping needs, and workflow dependencies for document generation processes.
* Assist with user training, adoption, troubleshooting, and ongoing support.
* Document business processes, automation workflows, template logic, and system configurations.

* Monitor system performance, adoption, and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience.
* Research emerging document automation technologies and industry best practices.
* Recommend enhancements that improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

* Familiarity with Salesforce, workflow automation platforms, and cloud\-based business applications.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale document generation or workflow automation initiatives.

As an Autonomy Systems Test Engineer, you will accelerate our product development by enabling our developers to build the safest and most reliable autonomous driving software possible. **Position Overview**
 Industrial projects don't wait for perfect conditions \- they demand skilled engineers who can solve complex problems, lead with confidence, and design structures that stand up to the realities of construction and operations. We are looking for Structural Engineering leaders, that have a strong background in structural design, with experience in leading other engineers and managing projects to support a variety of projects across North America. This role blends deep technical design expertise with hands\-on collaboration across disciplines, design and construction teams and project stakeholders. You will drive structural engineering from concept through construction, ensuring that every foundation, steel system and structural component is safe, efficient and buildable. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and want your work to directly influence cost, schedule and field construction, this is the level of impact you are looking for! Individuals with Steel, concrete and modularized equipment/buildings \- are a great fit!
   

  

 Most of our work is fast paced, design/build and EPC delivery. We are an employee\-owned company which fosters dedication and commitment to project success and are positioned as a key player in meeting growing infrastructure construction demands across the country. We cultivate a culture of excellence, innovation and teamwork, making it the most rewarding place to build your career. With top notch health benefits, great time off, flexible work options, a wealth\-building 401K plan and unbeatable growth opportunities \- we are deeply invested in the future of our employees.
   

  

**District Overview**
 Kiewit Engineering Group, Inc is a full\-service engineering consulting and design firm serving a broad range of the industrial markets. Our combined staff of more than 1,700 engineers and design professionals have expertise that spans all major engineering disciplines to serve the industrial, transportation, power, water/wastewater, mining, building, and oil, gas \& chemical markets. Our operations\-focused engineering provides our clients with safe and efficient facilities, and it integrates our 130 years of construction experience to finish projects on time and to make sure that Nobody Gets Hurt.
   

  

 Our rapidly growing Industrial Engineering team, which includes process, mechanical, electrical, controls, structural, architectural, geotechnical, and civil disciplines, is a multi\-faceted and leading\-edge division of Kiewit with best\-in\-class technical expertise focused on EPC and design\-build delivery of industrial projects in markets such as Food \& Beverage, Mineral Processing, Renewable Fuels, Pulp and Paper, Steel \& Aluminum, Industrial Buildings, and Industrial Energy, Water and Utilities.
   

  

**Location**
 These positions can either be based out of our Kansas City Kansas, Lone Tree, Colorado, or Minneapolis Minnesota offices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead structural design efforts for moderate to large industrial projects, including research, system selection, detailed analysis, and preparation of engineering drawings. Serve as the structural Lead on one or more projects as assigned.
* Apply and uphold department and industry standards while overseeing the development of structural calculations, drawings, and specifications to ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance.
* Mentor and guide entry‑ and mid‑level engineers and designers, providing technical direction, coaching, and performance feedback to support their professional growth.
* Utilize Building Information Modeling (BIM) to develop plans, models, drawings, and detailed structural documentation that support coordination and constructability.
* Integrate EPC and contractual requirements—including customer RFPs, professional service agreements, and project‑specific obligations—into the structural design approach to ensure alignment with project goals.
* Coordinate closely with internal and external partners, including cross‑discipline engineering teams, construction personnel, vendors, fabricators, and owners to resolve structural issues and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify and recommend improvements to standards, workflows, and processes to enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency across the department.
* Develop, monitor, and update project plans, schedules, and budgets, including staffing forecasts, and provide regular updates to project and department management. Support estimating, scheduling, and project controls with structural input as needed.
* Support department leadership in establishing and achieving performance goals, contributing to continuous improvement and long‑term departmental success.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering in structural, civil or architectural engineering program from an ABET accredited four\-year college or university program. Some masters’ coursework preferred.
* Current Professional Engineer License (PE) is required
* At least 15 years’ experience in structural engineering and design in both concrete and steel. At least 3 three years working in industrial, manufacturing, water/wastewater or building markets for both greenfield and brownfield projects. EPC and/or design/build experience is preferred.


 Experience with modular structural design highly desired.
   

  

* 3\+ years leading/mentoring a team of 3\-20 engineers/designers and leading a large project or 2\-6 smaller projects, where you are managing scope, schedule and manhour utilization. Must be able to communicate effectively and constructively with other team members and disciplines both verbally and written form.
* Functional in utilizing spreadsheets, databases, word processing, and computer operations
* Knowledgeable and experience in engineering software: CSi SAP2000 and SAFE, RISA Suite required.
* Knowledge and experience with BIM software: (Revit preferred), AutoCAD, and Navisworks. 3D modeling experience required
* Must be able to represent Kiewit Industrial Engineering in a professional manner to owners, contractors, vendors, and any other contacts outside Kiewit organization


 Other Requirements:
   

  

* Regular, reliable attendance
* Work productively and meet deadlines timely
* Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment
* Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies.
* Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required.


 Base Compensation: $138,000/yr \- $170,000
   

  

 (Actual compensation is subject to variation due to such factors as education, experience, skillset, and/or location)
   

  

 This posting will be active from: 05/19/2026 \- 07/28/2026
   

  

 We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top\-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

description_preview:
**Andersen Corporation Summary**
 At Andersen, we see possibility everywhere, every day and in everything we do. The possibility for our employees to achieve their full potential, for our communities to be stronger and for everyone to have a healthier, happier place to live.
   

  

 Our portfolio of brands — Andersen Windows \& Doors, Renewal by Andersen and Fenetres MQ — is crafted to serve customers across the new residential, home improvement and light commercial building sector.
   

  

 Join our more than 13,000 employees who are inspired every day to deliver exceptional experiences that turn possibility into reality.
   

  

**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION:**
 We are looking for an experienced or entry level Engineer to join our team at our Goodyear, Arizona facility. In this role you will develop, implement, and support all aspects of our quality system and processes including supplier quality, internal quality processes for fabrication and assembly. Develop standardized processes, drive continuous improvement, improve customer satisfaction, reduce waste, increase efficiency, audit, measure and monitor our production processes ensuring product conformance to specification.
 **This position is open for relocation assistance. This position is not open for sponsorship.**
**Primary Responsibilities**
* The development of quality systems, programs, training tools, documents, and standard operating procedures for critical to quality production processes ensuring consistent manufacturability of our custom products.
* Responsible for the preparation and execution of quality control plans, including the review of specifications, tolerances, capabilities and preparation of necessary supporting documentation and justification.
* Drive corrective action through root cause identification, structured problem solving and holding the gains on improvements. Perform root cause analysis to find sources of variation and process problems and use DMAIC tools to resolve them.
* Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submittals
* Responsible to assist in containment activities when reactive issues arise and ensure all customer issues (CAPA’s, etc.) are addressed, filed, and documented in a timely manner.
* Participate and lead regular weekly conference call in meetings with our supplier and internal customers to be informed of communications on current issues as well as proposed changes.
* Use Statistical Process Control to identify out\-of\-control conditions and define control plans to reduce process variation.
* Support in the resolution of customer complaints
* Participates in continuous improvement projects aligned to lean manufacturing principles aimed at built\-in quality, in\-process defect prevention, detection tools and reinforcement of next operator as customer mentality.
* Ensure all stages of Product Lifecycle Management by tracking impact through all levels process trials/changes (First Article, PPAP, Production trials) and effectively communicate results.
* Use participative team approach to problem solving and root cause analysis with Employees, Supervisors, Maintenance, Value Stream Managers, Materials Management, RD\&I and peers.
* Evaluate internal and supplier process/parts for non\-conformances, issue corrective action (5\-Why, CAPA, PDCA) documentation and evaluate responses root cause and countermeasures for effectiveness.
* Collaborate with delivery partners to determine appropriate projects of focus, using available data from observation, queries, process data, and working partner input.
* Assist in the development and verification of new test standards and equipment to meet the changing and growing customer requirements.
* Develop gauges and other tools for assessing conformance of manufactured parts to engineering specifications.
* Interface with Product Design, Product Engineering, and other business partners on the design for manufacturability, process capability and production builds of new product or product revisions


**Qualification And Skill Requirements**
* BS degree in Engineering or BA in natural science such as Chemistry or Physics
* Knowledge of quality programs, SPC, process capability and lean manufacturing principles
* Strong understanding of DMAIC tools; when to apply them, interpretation of results and application for effective solutions (process map, process capability, C\&E matrix, fishbone diagram, FMEA, MSA, DOE, control plan) drive improvement activity.
* Demonstrates self\-driven personal growth and development.
* Able to read and interpret drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
* Ability to present and articulate quality programs, continuous improvement methodologies and problem\-solving techniques in a clear, concise, and logical manner.
* Ability to gather and analyze data through statistical techniques: perform and analyze process capability studies.
* Build cooperative relationships across the organization. Interface with Business Partner groups responsible for our processes and or methodologies.
* Identify projects that will target the reduction of process variation, containment of supplier defects and elimination of non\-standard work to drive continuous improvement.
* Monitor product and process statistical trends for changes and lead/drive continuous improvement activities associated with improved customer satisfaction, waste reduction and elimination of process variation.
* Understand and effectively balance daily workload between tactical and strategic projects.
* Experience implementing process control charting.
* CAD experience
* Usage of computer software tools, such as Power BI, Power Apps, Word, Excel PowerPoint, or Minitab, to analyze data to detect trends and abnormalities.
* Good organization, prioritization, and project management skills.


**Pay Range**
 $78,824\.00 \- $122,176\.00
   

  

**Culture And Benefits**
 At Andersen, we believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, their talent, dedication and passion enables us to be the most trusted window \& door company. To support our employees, we provide a comprehensive Total Rewards Package – a thoughtful combination of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to investing in each team member’s wellbeing and success. While specific benefits may vary by position or location, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Package designed to support your well‑being, growth, and future. Our benefits include:
   

  

* 401 (k) Plan, Employer Fixed Contributions \& Company Matching
* Profit Sharing\*
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage\*
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\*, Health Savings Account (HSA) and Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
* Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off \& Paid Holidays
* Paid Maternity Leave \& Paid Parental Leave\*
* Career Growth Planning \& Nationwide Career Opportunities
* For employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement, some benefits may differ or may not be available based on the terms of the agreement.


**PROFIT SHARING:** 
 In 2026 Andersen has set a profit\-sharing target of $3,600 per eligible employee, prorated as appropriate. Profit Sharing will be paid out in quarterly installments to provide eligible employees with payments throughout the year, with payment amounts tied to quarterly operating profit performance.
   

  

 EEOC EMPLOYER: Andersen is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, marital status, national origin, citizenship, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Andersen Corporation will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable federal, state and local laws.
   

  

 We look forward to seeing how your unique skills, background and experiences will inspire our team and help us continue to be the leader we are today.

This role defines how Arzana scales while delivering massive efficiency gains to operators.

* Join a fast\-growing YC P26 startup as one of the first engineering hires, reporting directly to the founders and defining the company's operational DNA.

* Receive a highly competitive package including $120K\-$150K salary and a significant $400K equity stake with relocation support to New York City.


**What You Will Do**
* Embed directly with customers at manufacturing facilities to understand complex RFQ flows and translate operational friction into automated software solutions.
* Ship end\-to\-end features, from agent configuration and ERP integrations to migration scripts, maintaining full ownership of everything you scope and build.
* Drive the core product roadmap by identifying breakage and opportunities on\-site before anyone else, ensuring the product evolves with real\-world manufacturing needs.

* Demonstrates full\-stack proficiency in Python, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, with the ability to quickly master LLM orchestration and complex agent workflows.
* Maintains exceptional interpersonal skills to build immediate trust with C\-suite operators and a builder bias that prioritizes shipping high\-quality code at speed.

 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career.  And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.
